style.styleTitle: Personalised Photo Upload Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: Whether it s baby s first Christmas, a first Christmas as a married couple or to remember someone who s no longer with us, you choose exactly what adorns this tree decoration by uploading your photograph to sit within this beautiful glass bauble. Simply add in your email address to obtain a photo upload link. Please ensure the image is of the highest quality possible. Bauble comes supplied with a ribbon ready to hang straight onto the tree. Colour of ribbon may vary. Great for Christmas and Memorials.
